description:
Who We Are 
 
 Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world. 
 
 What We Offer 
 
 Location:
Hwaseong-Lucestar,KOR 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 
 1. Korea expert of Metrology eBeam(SEM) Algorithm development and support group(R&D TCT[Technology and Collaboration Team]) for Algorithm matters 
 
 2. Algorithm Development 
 Working cooperation with algorithm development group in PDC & AMIND 
 Algorithm integration in large systems considering HW and SW aspects 
 Engage in customer facing activities to aid algorithms' proliferation at customer sites 
 Extending tool performance with the customer oriented algorithm development for improving data reliability & measurement success, etc. 
 Provide software specifications and production code on time to meet project milestones 
 Close work with the applications, system, physics, software, and qualification groups in order to understand the customers’ requirements and system constraints 
 Develop state of the art algorithms in the fields of Computer Vision, Machine Learning and Deep Learning , etc. 
 Participating in communication chain with customer to clear understand VoC and challenges from a technical perspective to develop in the right direction 
 Performing C&F for CIP and  preliminary research for new feature in next generation algo development, and beta testing in customer site
  
 3. Algorithm Support at Customer Site 
 Application support for algorithm-induced challenges, such as measurement error, data reliability, correlation, and matching issues, etc. at customer site 
 Providing the solution on Algorithm issues – Diagnostics(R/C) and troubleshooting 
 Guiding new implemented Algorithm feature and providing training for account Apps 
 Algorithm bug fixing – Support for worldwide reported bug fixing as a member of Algorithm developer 
 Communicate issues and feedback to Metrology/Inspection Algorithm group and get inputs for troubleshooting at customer site 
 Demonstrate excellent communication skills to improve customer satisfaction 
 
 Requirements: 
 Bachelor's degree, Master’s degree and above 
 Strong theoretical foundation and >3year proven hands-on experience in Computer Vision and Image Processing algorithms 
 Thorough understanding of probability and statistics 
 Strong skills in developing in MATLAB and Python 
 Ability to work independently as well as part of a team 
 Fluent English – verbal and text 
 Team player with excellent communication and collaboration skills 
 Travel – capable for initial 1-2 months travel and later willingness to travel up to 30% 
 
 Preferred: 
 Theoretical and hands-on experience in detection, segmentation, image enhancement and simulations 
 Theoretical and hands-on experience in Machine Learning 
 Theoretical and hands-on experience in Deep Learning 
 Understanding of imaging systems and physics 
 Development experience in Java and C/C++ 
 Experience in multidisciplinary and matrix organization 
 Experienced with semiconductors organizations 
 
 
 Additional Information 
 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
 
 Relocation Eligible: 
No 
 
 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
